title: A Survey on Out-of-Distribution Evaluation of Neural NLP Models

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying methods that evaluate models on debiased datasets, generated either by breaking spurious correlations (e.g., heuristics-based syntactic templates, counterfactual text manipulation, word scrambling) or by systematically filtering out examples containing superficial patterns like lexical overlap and positional bias.

Reviewing evaluation protocols that partition data into sub-populations based on metadata attributes of individuals (e.g., demographics/race) to measure variations in model performance across different groups.
